title: Taenia solium TAF6 and TAF9 bind to a downstream promoter element present in the Tstbp1 gene core promoter.
authors: Rodriguez-Lima, Oscar; Garcia-Gutierrez, Ponciano; Jimenez, Lucia; Velazquez-Villegas, Laura A; Zarain-Herzberg, Angel; Lazzarini, Roberto; Estrada, Karel; Landa, Abraham
one_liner_zh: 该文研究绦虫TAF6-TAF9与下游启动子元件DPE的蛋白-DNA互作，并用分子动力学模拟构建结合模型，虽非典型TF-DNA体系但方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Transcription regulation in cestodes has been little studied. Here, we characterize the Taenia solium TATA-binding protein (TBP) gene. We found binding sites for transcription factors such as NF1, YY1, and AP-1 in the proximal promoter. We also identified two TATA-like elements in the promoter; however, neither could bind TBP. Additionally, we mapped the transcription start site (A+1) within an initiator and identified a putative downstream promoter element (DPE) located at +27 bp relative to the transcription start site. These two elements are important and functional for gene expression. Moreover, we identified the genes encoding T. solium TBP-Associated Factor 6 (TsTAF6) and 9 (TsTAF9). A Western blot assay revealed that both factors are expressed in the parasite; electrophoretic mobility shift assays and super-shift assays revealed interactions between the DPE probe and TsTAF6-TsTAF9. Finally, we used molecular dynamics simulations to formulate an interaction model among TsTAF6, TsTAF9, and the DPE probe; we stabilized the model with interactions between the histone fold domain pair in TAFs and several pairs of nucleotides in the DPE probe. We discuss novel and interesting features of the TsTAF6-TsTAF9 complex for interaction with DPE on T. solium promoters.
abstract_zh: 绦虫的转录调控研究甚少。在此，我们表征了猪带绦虫TATA结合蛋白（TBP）基因。我们在近端启动子中发现了转录因子如NF1、YY1和AP-1的结合位点。我们还鉴定了启动子中的两个TATA样元件；然而，两者均不能结合TBP。此外，我们定位了起始子内的转录起始位点（A+1），并鉴定了一个假定的下游启动子元件（DPE），其位于转录起始位点下游+27 bp处。这两个元件对基因表达至关重要且具有功能性。进一步，我们鉴定了编码猪带绦虫TBP相关因子6（TsTAF6）和9（TsTAF9）的基因。Western blot实验显示这两种因子在寄生虫中均有表达；电泳迁移率变动分析和超迁移实验揭示了DPE探针与TsTAF6-TsTAF9之间的相互作用。最后，我们利用分子动力学模拟构建了TsTAF6、TsTAF9与DPE探针之间的相互作用模型；我们通过TAFs中的组蛋白折叠域对与DPE探针中几对核苷酸之间的相互作用稳定了该模型。我们讨论了TsTAF6-TsTAF9复合物与猪带绦虫启动子上DPE相互作用的新颖且有趣的特性。
